summary: Reported overnight technology futures strength improves Friday relief potential, but elevated oil and near-certain reported December tightening leave the three-day bearish skew intact.

Reuters reports Asian equities recovering; Wednesday US cash recovered sharply from lows.
bearish: Reuters reports Brent $96.61 and WTI $85.78; supply risk persists.
Reuters reports 99% probability of December 25 bp hike and rising Treasury yields after reopening.
Prior US cash QQQ underperformed SPY and chip weakness remains unconfirmed as reversed.

editorial.marketOverview: FT reports a stronger overnight technology rebound, with Nasdaq futures up 2.2% and S&P futures up 1.5%. Reuters reports Asian recovery alongside elevated crude and rising Treasury yields. US cash has not yet reopened.
editorial.whatChanged: Compared with 23:29 ET, reported US futures leadership is more constructive, but exact observation times are unavailable. Reuters reports 99% December hike pricing and crude near Thursday highs. Open Watch remains at 181 events. Friday relief potential improves without establishing a sustained three-day reversal.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Overnight relative strength is encouraging but cannot substitute for SOX cash leadership or broad participation. Higher yields and oil constrain duration-sensitive valuations; the expected equity impact of supply disruption is not an observed causal response.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday: stronger relief potential in shortened trading, with fade risk. Monday: normal liquidity and weekend OPEC+ policy test durability. Tuesday: JOLTS and tentative chip earnings may redirect rates and technology leadership.
editorial.bullCase: A sustained cash rebound with SOX outperforming, broad participation, lower volatility and falling oil would invalidate the bearish skew. Overnight futures are a preliminary positive signal.
editorial.bearCase: A failure to hold overnight gains alongside elevated crude, higher yields and renewed chip weakness would reinforce downside risk. Near-certain reported December tightening limits valuation relief.
editorial.watchNext: Confirm futures quotes and cash SOX relative strength, VXN/VIX, breadth and paired yields; monitor Friday 13:00 ET close, Sunday OPEC+ and Tuesday JOLTS. Verify issuer earnings dates.
